question: At 1 THz, what refractive index and real permittivity did the Sn24W-GST film annealed at 250 °C have?
rendered: According to Table 1 on page 7, the Sn24W-GST film annealed at 250 °C had a refractive index of 26.14 and a real permittivity of 49.43.
